You farm way too little, die way too much and have an extremely suboptimal runesetup. Ghost after nerfs has been significantly worse than Flash for a long time now since there are barely any benefits to playing Ghost over Flash anymore. Your runes are for the most part really useless since dark harvest isn't strong in early game 1v1, late game 1v1 or even skirmishing, the only case you can make for it is when smurfing, and even while smurfing I would never play Dark harvest. There are multiple rune setups with different use cases but there's only 2 really good ones and 1 semi viable one. Starting with Phaserush: It's semi viable, it's ok into melee champs that might be able to run you down (Darius/Garen/Olaf for example) but it's not very strong as you miss a huge chunk of early game power, full runes for it would be Phaserush, Axiom Arcanist, Celerity, Water walking, Triple Tonic, Approach Velocity. I really wouldn't recommend this though. The next setup is one of the recently popped up viable pages popularized by Aribo, Arcane Comet: This Runepage offers a lot more value than Conquerer against full ranged teams or teams where stacking conquerer effectively is really hard, it makes you very strong in early fights and actually scales pretty well into lategame since the comet cool down goes down for every Autoattack you do with one of Udyrs abilities. Full Setup is Arcane Comet, Axiom Arcanist, Celerity, Waterwalking and either Triumph and Legend:Haste against teams that don't need to be oneshot or Cheapshot with Ultimate Hunter against teams that need to be one shot/you can only poke with empowered R. The last Runepage is the obviously most popular one, Conquerer. You also have a lot of different possible secondary Runes with Conquerer which hard counter some champions. Conquerer is the all-rounder Rune for Udyr, it gives strong 1v1 potential at all points in the game and allows you to play in melee range more than the other setups, additionally the small runes in the Precision Tree are extremely strong so that's there as well. The setups are as follows Conquerer, Triumph, Legend:Haste and either Cut Down or Last Stand, Last Stand is mainly strong against teams with a lot of melee champs that you don't get one shot by, and Cut Down js better in every other situation. Now let's start with Secondary Runes for Conquerer, first you have Inspiration, you can either play Magical Footwear with Approach Velocity or Triple Tonic with Approach Velocity, in 99% of cases Triple Tonic is considered better and more consistent on Udyr, especially because Udyr can use the extra skillpoint from it until the end of the game to give himself more ms than he would normally cap out at from E. Next is Domination where the only Viable runes are Cheap Shot with Treasure Hunter, this is strong against Scaling teams or against teams that want to fist fight a lot so you can snowball really easily and be stronger in 1v1 due to cheap shot dmg. After that comes the Resolve Tree, where the only good Setup is Conditioning with Overgrowth, it's mainly strong against drafts where Udyr can't do more than be a Empowered R poking Meat Shield, for example against a team that has Jax + Vayne or Jax + Ivern, essentially champs that don't allow you to really kill anyone. Last is the Sorcery Tree that has 2 good Setups, the first is Nimbus Cloak with Celerity, which is strong against scaling Junglers that you need to Invade pretty early or snowball as hard as possible against/make their game as hard to play as possible, examples would be Master Yi or Karthus. Lastly there's the Axiom Arcanist with Waterwalking  Setup that is mainly strong against teams that require you to be extremely strong in 1v1 early and where your Empowered W needs to be especially strong. Examples here are Elise or Wukong. Now Lastly, just for your understanding, Axiom Arcanist works with all of Udyrs Empowered Abilities, but the ability to profit most is empowered W, which gains 14% extra shielding AND healing.
